title: Balancing Prayer Times at the Office
paragraphs: Starting a new job at a company without a dedicated prayer room, Malik feels unsure how to fit his daily prayers into a busy schedule full of back-to-back meetings.
During his first week, he quietly asks his manager about using an empty meeting room for a few minutes during Dhuhr, worried the request might seem unusual or inconvenient to others.

His manager agrees immediately, mentioning that another colleague already does something similar, and Malik realizes his worry had been mostly unnecessary, since nobody at the office seemed bothered at all.

A month later, Malik has built prayer breaks smoothly into his daily schedule, and reflecting on it, he feels grateful he asked directly instead of silently worrying about a simple, reasonable request.
